security_audit.summary: Most static filesystem, network, environment, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from setup documentation, placeholders, and Markdown formatting. Several Firebase CLI instructions are confirmed as medium-risk because they run npx-based tooling, authenticate users, or alter project context. The main semantic concern is forceful agent-control wording that may override normal user intent.

remediation.suggestion: Replace always-use and do-not-proceed language with scoped guidance that respects the current user request and existing agent policies.
Require explicit user confirmation before running Firebase CLI login, project selection, service initialization, or npx commands with side effects.
Tell agents to show proposed MCP configuration changes, preserve existing entries, and ask before editing global or home-directory config files.

content.user_title: Set Up Firebase Projects with AI Agents
content.value_statement: Firebase setup often requires CLI, authentication, and project context checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Firebase setup workflows.
actual_capabilities: Checks Node.js and Firebase CLI prerequisites before Firebase work starts.
Guides Firebase CLI login and active project selection.
Explains project creation and service initialization through Firebase CLI prompts.
Configures Firebase MCP server setup for supported AI agent environments.
Shows Firebase web app registration, SDK installation, and modular service imports.
Points agents to Firebase CLI help and official Firebase knowledge resources.
limitations: Requires authenticated Firebase CLI access for project operations.
Interactive installs, logins, and application restarts still need user participation.
Does not replace Firebase console permissions, billing setup, or security review.
Web examples focus on JavaScript and may need adaptation for other platforms.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Firebase Workspace
use_cases.description: Verify Node.js, install Firebase CLI access, sign in, and select the correct active project before development begins.

use_cases.title: Connect an Agent to Firebase MCP
use_cases.description: Add or verify Firebase MCP configuration for tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Antigravity.

use_cases.title: Start Firebase Services in an App
use_cases.description: Use Firebase CLI guidance to create projects, initialize services, and add Firebase web SDK setup to an application.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Firebase Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the firebase-basics skill to check whether my local environment is ready for Firebase development. Ask before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Select the Right Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the firebase-basics workflow to verify my active Firebase project and help me set the correct project alias.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Firebase MCP
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firebase-basics to review my agent environment and propose Firebase MCP setup steps. Show any configuration changes before applying them.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize Firebase for a Web App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firebase-basics to create a Firebase setup plan for this web app, including project creation, service initialization, SDK setup, and verification.

output_examples.input: Check whether my machine is ready for Firebase development.
output: Node.js version is verified or installation guidance is provided.
Firebase CLI availability is checked through the recommended workflow.
Authentication status and active project context are reviewed with user confirmation.

output_examples.input: Help me connect Cursor to Firebase MCP.
output: The expected Cursor MCP configuration location is identified.
Existing Firebase MCP settings are checked before any edit is proposed.
A restart and connection verification step is included.

output_examples.input: Add Firebase to my web app.
output: The workflow covers project and web app registration.
SDK installation and app initialization steps are outlined.
Service imports are added only for the Firebase products the app uses.

best_practices: Confirm the active Firebase project before running setup or deployment commands.
Ask the user before authentication, global installs, or persistent configuration changes.
Use official Firebase CLI help and Firebase knowledge sources when commands or workflows are unclear.
anti_patterns: Do not run Firebase CLI commands against an unknown active project.
Do not overwrite existing MCP server configuration entries.
Do not treat placeholder Firebase web config values as production-ready settings.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents prepare Firebase CLI access, choose a project, configure MCP, and start web SDK setup.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it create Firebase projects?
faq.answer: It provides Firebase CLI guidance for project creation, but the authenticated user must have the required permissions.

faq.question: Does it configure MCP automatically?
faq.answer: It documents MCP configuration steps. Users should review and approve any persistent config changes.

faq.question: Is a Firebase web API key a secret?
faq.answer: Firebase web API keys are client configuration values. Service account keys and private credentials must still be protected.

faq.question: What should users verify before deployment?
faq.answer: Users should verify authentication, active project, initialized services, billing needs, and Firebase security rules.
